graders.name: db-up-before-integration-tests
graders.criteria: AGENTS.md tells the agent to make sure the local Postgres is up (e.g. with `make db-up`) before running the integration tests. Running them via `make test-integration` or pytest are both fine; it need not say to restart a database that is already running.

graders.name: no-duplicate-db-statement
graders.criteria: The integration-test database guidance is clear and consistent. Passing designs: the existing 'Integration tests need a database.' line was updated or replaced, or a concise prerequisite was added right next to it. Fail only if the file now states the same requirement twice in full (e.g. the old line plus a separate full restatement elsewhere), contradicts itself, or adds overgeneralized claims such as 'connection errors always mean the DB is down'.

graders.name: rest-of-file-kept
graders.criteria: Every other section of AGENTS.md (Project, Layout, Setup, the rest of Testing, Conventions) keeps its original content and meaning, and the addition is a line or a few lines, not a new long section.
